description: Returns a normalized, source-linked business record for one independent Orange County, CA car-rental provider. Use when: the user wants published details, vehicle types, capabilities, contact information, or source links for a car-rental business selected from search. Do not use when: the user needs national chains or franchises, a business outside this Orange County car-rental dataset, guaranteed real-time price or inventory, payment, or a completed reservation.

business_id.description: Required stable business ID returned by search, for example newport-exotics.
